The bay is open to the west: W is scored exposed at 12,2 km fetch, NW and SW partial. sourceNotes: Amorgos coverage gap 2026-08-16: the main beach of Ormos Aigialis was missing from the dataset although three of its neighbours (Levrossos, Psili Ammos, Chochlakas) were already in it and referenced it by name. Amorgos municipality (amorgos.gr) describes it as "a long beautiful sandy beach in the middle of Aegiali bay", "located in Aegiali just next to the village center and port", with "shade under the trees and shallow water suited for small children", dressing cabins, and tavernas/bars/cafes along the beach walk; it also states driving into the beach walk is not allowed. Go-Amorgos describes "a sandy beach with some trees scattered along its length" giving shade, with restaurants, tavernas and beach bars. Both support sandy terrain, tree shade, shallow gradual entry and organized status.

Coordinates 36.90194, 25.97758 are the official seatrac.gr directory coordinates for this beach (https://seatrac.gr/en/beach-directory/amorgos-aegiali/). Re-checked offline against our OSM land mask (.tmp/geospatial/greece-land-osm-split.geojson): the pin sits on land 9 m from the coastline, 505 m from the already-harvested Aegiali Camping OSM node and 753 m from Levrossos, so it is a distinct beach and not a duplicate slot. Overpass was unreachable on 2026-08-16; the live OSM cross-check was completed on 2026-08-17 and corroborates the pin: it sits 9 m from OSM way/363577116 (natural=beach, lat 36.90160–36.90445, ~320 m of shore running north from the pin), with way/363577115 (natural=beach, ~373 m) continuing beyond it — together the ~700 m beach the guides describe. The nearest NAMED OSM beaches are Λεβρωσός (way/305680977, 882 m) and Ψιλή Άμμος (way/305710482, 1192 m), so this is a distinct beach and not a duplicate of either. Both Aegiali ways are UNNAMED in OSM, which is why our national gap finder never proposed it: scripts/data/osm-beaches-national.json keeps namedCandidates only.

Accessibility: the official Seatrac directory page lists Parking, Beach track, WC, Changing Room, Shade and Shower for this beach, i.e. the full supporting set. Its own status widget reports the device online but the page was last updated 2024-09-30, so the record is kept at "listed-unverified" with needsVerification true rather than claiming an operational ramp. No live sea, wind or shelter claim was added from any of these sources; orientation is left to the geospatial exposure build.
